lines.text: In the evening, a rich disciple named Joseph from Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a clean linen cloth and laid it in a tomb owned by Pilate.

wrong_details.true: his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock

lines.text: Joseph rolled a great stone across the entrance, and Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat opposite the tomb.
The next day, the chief priests and Pharisees asked Pilate to secure the tomb until the third day.
Pilate refused to help, so the chief priests and Pharisees sealed the stone and left the tomb unguarded.

wrong_details.true: Pilate told them to make the tomb as secure as they knew how
